headlines.title: Huge waves pummel the California coast, forcing the closure of iconic piers
headlines.description: A large tree fell onto northbound lanes of Highway 280, just south of San Bruno on Sunday, according to the California Highway Patrol. CHP said the incident occurred around 7:20 p.m. Authorities said one car crashed into the tree before CHP was able to conduct a traffic break and divert the traffic around the tree. Officials said Caltrans is working on clearing the tree.
